title: Lone Pine at SemEval-2021 Task 5: Fine-Grained Detection of Hate Speech Using BERToxic
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation and performance (F1-score) of a system for the Toxic Spans Detection task. While hate speech is a socio-ethical issue, the paper does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning; it treats toxicity detection as a linguistic classification problem.
